entities.name: Rin Seikō
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Rin Seikō  was a scholar-bureaucrat and diplomat of the Ryūkyū Kingdom. He was known for leading a movement to petition the government of Qing Dynasty China to rescue the Ryūkyū Kingdom from annexation by Imperial Japan.
